ActiveFlowLog.description_en: Activates a flow log to start capturing traffic of specified resources
ActiveFlowLog.description_zh: 启动流日志，启动后开始捕获指定资源的流量

AddTrafficMatchRuleToTrafficMarkingPolic.description_en: Adds traffic classification rules to a traffic marking policy by calling the AddTrafficMatchRuleToTrafficMarkingPolicy operation
AddTrafficMatchRuleToTrafficMarkingPolic.description_zh: 调用AddTrafficMatchRuleToTrafficMarkingPolicy接口为流量标记策略添加流分类规则

AddTraficMatchRuleToTrafficMarkingPolicy.description_en: Adds traffic classification rules to a traffic marking policy
AddTraficMatchRuleToTrafficMarkingPolicy.description_zh: 为流量标记策略添加流分类规则

AssociateCenBandwidthPackage.description_en: Associates a bandwidth package instance with a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
AssociateCenBandwidthPackage.description_zh: 将带宽包实例绑定至云企业网实例

AssociateTransitRouterMulticastDomain.description_en: Associates a vSwitch in a virtual private cloud (VPC) with a multicast domain by calling the AssociateTransitRouterMulticastDomain operation so that resources in the VPC can communicate through multicast
AssociateTransitRouterMulticastDomain.description_zh: 为了VPC下的资源可以实现组播通信，调用AssociateTransitRouterMulticastDomain接口将专有网络（VPC）下的交换机（VSwitch）关联到组播域中

AttachCenChildInstance.description_en: Attaches a network instance to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
AttachCenChildInstance.description_zh: 调用AttachCenChildInstance接口将网络实例加载到云企业网实例中

CheckTransitRouterService.description_en: Queries whether the transit router service is activated for the current Alibaba Cloud account
CheckTransitRouterService.description_zh: 查询当前阿里云账号是否已开通转发路由器服务

CreateCen.description_en: A Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance is the fundamental resource for managing an integrated network. A CEN instance manages one network and can span one or more regions. Before enabling connectivity between network instances, call the CreateCen operation to create a CEN instance
CreateCen.description_zh: 云企业网实例是管理一体化网络的基础资源。一个云企业网实例管理一张网络，可覆盖一个或多个地域。在实现网络实例互通前，您需要先调用CreateCen接口创建一个云企业网实例

CreateCenBandwidthPackage.description_en: Creates a bandwidth plan for Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) to enable cross-region connectivity between network instances
CreateCenBandwidthPackage.description_zh: 要实现跨地域网络实例互通，您必须购买带宽包。您可以调用CreateCenBandwidthPackage接口创建带宽包

CreateCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToAttach.description_en: Adds a route entry to a network instance connected to an Enterprise Edition transit router. The destination CIDR block points to the transit router in the current region as the next hop
CreateCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToAttach.description_zh: 在企业版转发路由器中，您可以调用CreateCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToAttachment接口为网络实例添加路由条目，目标网段的下一跳指向当前地域的转发路由器

CreateCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToCen.description_en: Adds a route entry to a network instance by calling the CreateCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToCen operation
CreateCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToCen.description_zh: 调用CreateCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToCen接口为网络实例添加路由条目

CreateCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicy.description_en: Creates a cross-region traffic scheduling policy for an Enterprise Edition transit router to optimize and control network traffic across regions
CreateCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicy.description_zh: 如果您需要优化和控制跨区域的网络流量，您可以调用CreateCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicy接口创建企业版转发路由器下的跨地域流量调度策略

CreateCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueue.description_en: Creates a queue configuration under a traffic scheduling policy. If you need to manage different types and priorities of network traffic to ensure the performance of critical service traffic and comply with Service-Level Agreements (SLAs), you can call the CreateCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueue operation
CreateCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueue.description_zh: 如果您需要对不同类型和优先级的网络流量进行细致管理，以确保关键业务流量的性能并遵守服务级别协议，您可以调用CreateCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueue接口创建流量调度策略下队列的配置

CreateCenRouteMap.description_en: Creates a routing policy. The routing policy feature allows you to filter route information and customize the management of cloud network connectivity
CreateCenRouteMap.description_zh: 通过路由策略功能，可以过滤路由信息，帮助您自定义管理云上网络互通能力，您可以调用CreateCenRouteMap接口创建路由策略

CreateTrafficMarkingPolicy.description_en: A traffic marking policy captures traffic that matches traffic classification rules and adds a Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) value to the traffic as a mark. Creates a traffic marking policy by calling CreateTrafficMarkingPolicy
CreateTrafficMarkingPolicy.description_zh: 流量标记策略通过流分类规则捕获符合规则的流量，捕获后，您可以为流量添加DSCP（Differentiated Services Code Point）值作为标记。您可以通过调用CreateTrafficMarkingPolicy创建流量标记策略

CreateTransitRouter.description_en: Calls the CreateTransitRouter operation to create an Enterprise Edition transit router instance
CreateTransitRouter.description_zh: 调用CreateTransitRouter接口创建企业版转发路由器实例

CreateTransitRouterCidr.description_en: A transit router CIDR block is a custom CIDR block that you define for a transit router, similar to a CIDR block used to assign IP addresses to a router loopback interface. Calls the CreateTransitRouterCidr operation to create a CIDR block for a transit router
CreateTransitRouterCidr.description_zh: 转发路由器地址段是您为转发路由器自定义的一个地址段，该地址段类似于为路由器环回口（Loopback接口）分配IP地址的地址段。您可以调用CreateTransitRouterCidr接口创建转发路由器下CIDR地址段

CreateTransitRouterEcrAttachment.description_en: Creates a connection between an Express Connect Router (ECR) instance and a transit router instance in the same region
CreateTransitRouterEcrAttachment.description_zh: 您可以调用CreateTransitRouterEcrAttachment接口将要互通的专线网关ECR（ExpressConnect Router）网络实例连接到同地域的转发路由器实例中

CreateTransitRouterMulticastDomain.description_en: Creates a multicast domain. A multicast domain defines the scope of a multicast network within a region. Only resources within the multicast domain can send and receive multicast traffic. Resources outside the multicast domain cannot send or receive multicast traffic
CreateTransitRouterMulticastDomain.description_zh: 组播域是在地域范围内定义一个组播网络的范围，只有组播域之内的资源可以发送和接收组播流量，组播域之外的资源无法发送和接收组播流量，您可以调用CreateTransitRouterMulticastDomain接口创建组播域

CreateTransitRouterPeerAttachment.description_en: After network instances (VPCs, VBRs, and IPsec connections) are connected to a transit router, you must create an inter-region connection between transit routers to enable communication between network instances in different regions. You can call the CreateTransitRouterPeerAttachment operation to create an inter-region connection for an Enterprise Edition transit router instance
CreateTransitRouterPeerAttachment.description_zh: 网络实例（VPC、VBR、IPsec连接）被连接至转发路由器后，如果要实现不同地域网络实例的互通，需要在网络实例连接的转发路由器下创建跨地域连接，您可以调用CreateTransitRouterPeerAttachment接口为企业版转发路由器实例创建跨地域连接

CreateTransitRouterPrefixListAssociation.description_en: Associates a prefix list with an Enterprise Edition transit router route table
CreateTransitRouterPrefixListAssociation.description_zh: 为企业版转发路由器路由表绑定前缀列表

CreateTransitRouterRouteEntry.description_en: Adds a route entry to a route table of an Enterprise Edition transit router
CreateTransitRouterRouteEntry.description_zh: 在企业版转发路由器的路由表中添加路由条目

CreateTransitRouterRouteTable.description_en: Creates a custom route table for an Enterprise Edition transit router by calling the CreateTransitRouterRouteTable operation
CreateTransitRouterRouteTable.description_zh: 调用CreateTransitRouterRouteTable接口为企业版转发路由器创建自定义路由表

CreateTransitRouterVbrAttachment.description_en: Invokes the CreateTransitRouterVbrAttachment operation to connect a Virtual Border Router (VBR) network instance to a transit router instance in the same region. After the connection is established, the transit router can help you achieve private network peering
CreateTransitRouterVbrAttachment.description_zh: 您可以调用CreateTransitRouterVbrAttachment接口将要互通的边界路由器VBR（Virtual Border Router）网络实例连接到同地域的转发路由器实例中。连接后，转发路由器可帮您实现私网互通

CreateTransitRouterVpcAttachment.description_en: Calls the CreateTransitRouterVpcAttachment operation to connect a Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) instance to a transit router instance for private network peering. After the connection is established, the transit router instance can help you achieve private network peering
CreateTransitRouterVpcAttachment.description_zh: 调用CreateTransitRouterVpcAttachment接口将要互通的专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）实例连接至转发路由器实例。连接后，转发路由器实例可以帮助您实现私网互通

CreateTransitRouterVpnAttachment.description_en: Transit routers support connections to IPsec connections of VPN gateways. An on-premises data center can directly connect to a transit router through an IPsec connection, and then communicate with other networks through the transit router. Calls the CreateTransitRouterVpnAttachment operation to create a VPN connection
CreateTransitRouterVpnAttachment.description_zh: 转发路由器支持连接VPN网关的IPsec连接。本地数据中心可以通过IPsec连接直接连接至转发路由器，然后通过转发路由器实现与其他网络的互通，调用CreateTransitRouterVpnAttachment接口创建VPN连接

DeactiveFlowLog.description_en: Deactivates a flow log. After the flow log is deactivated, traffic of the specified resource is no longer captured
DeactiveFlowLog.description_zh: 停止流日志，停止后不再捕获指定资源的流量

DeleteCen.description_en: Deletes a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
DeleteCen.description_zh: 调用DeleteCen接口删除云企业网实例

DeleteCenBandwidthPackage.description_en: Deletes a bandwidth plan instance by calling the DeleteCenBandwidthPackage operation
DeleteCenBandwidthPackage.description_zh: 调用DeleteCenBandwidthPackage接口删除带宽包实例

DeleteCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToAttach.description_en: Deletes a route entry from a network instance connected to an Enterprise Edition transit router
DeleteCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToAttach.description_zh: 调用DeleteCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToAttachment接口删除企业版转发路由器连接的网络实例的路由条目

DeleteCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToCen.description_en: Deletes a route entry from a network instance by calling the DeleteCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToCen operation
DeleteCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToCen.description_zh: 调用DeleteCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToCen接口删除网络实例下的路由条目

DeleteCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicy.description_en: Deletes a traffic scheduling policy by calling the DeleteCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicy operation
DeleteCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicy.description_zh: 调用DeleteCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicy接口删除流量调度策略

DeleteCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueue.description_en: Deletes a queue from a traffic scheduling policy by calling the DeleteCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueue operation
DeleteCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueue.description_zh: 调用DeleteCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueue接口删除流量调度策略下的队列

DeleteCenRouteMap.description_zh: 调用DeleteCenRouteMap接口删除指定的路由策略

DeleteRouteServiceInCen.description_en: Call the DeleteRouteServiceInCen operation to delete the configuration of an Alibaba Cloud service from a Basic Edition transit router
DeleteRouteServiceInCen.description_zh: 调用DeleteRouteServiceInCen接口删除基础版转发路由器云服务配置

DeleteTrafficMarkingPolicy.description_zh: 调用DeleteTrafficMarkingPolicy接口删除流量标记策略

DeleteTransitRouter.description_en: Calls the DeleteTransitRouter operation to delete an Enterprise Edition transit router instance
DeleteTransitRouter.description_zh: 调用DeleteTransitRouter接口删除企业版转发路由器实例

DeleteTransitRouterCidr.description_en: Deletes a CIDR block from a transit router
DeleteTransitRouterCidr.description_zh: 删除转发路由器下CIDR地址段

DeleteTransitRouterEcrAttachment.description_en: Deletes an Express Connect Router (ECR) connection from an Enterprise Edition transit router
DeleteTransitRouterEcrAttachment.description_zh: 调用DeleteTransitRouterEcrAttachment接口删除企业版转发路由器下的专线网关ECR（ExpressConnect Router）连接

DeleteTransitRouterMulticastDomain.description_en: Deletes a multicast domain by calling the DeleteTransitRouterMulticastDomain operation

DeleteTransitRouterPeerAttachment.description_en: Calls the DeleteTransitRouterPeerAttachment operation to delete an inter-region connection from an Enterprise Edition transit router
DeleteTransitRouterPeerAttachment.description_zh: 调用DeleteTransitRouterPeerAttachment接口删除企业版转发路由器下的跨地域连接

DeleteTransitRouterPrefixListAssociation.description_en: Dissociates a prefix list from an Enterprise Edition transit router route table
DeleteTransitRouterPrefixListAssociation.description_zh: 解除企业版转发路由器路由表与前缀列表的绑定关系

DeleteTransitRouterRouteEntry.description_en: Calls the DeleteTransitRouterRouteEntry operation to delete static route entries of the blackhole or connection instance type from an Enterprise Edition transit router forward route table
DeleteTransitRouterRouteEntry.description_zh: 调用DeleteTransitRouterRouteEntry接口删除企业版转发路由器路由表中黑洞、连接实例类型的静态配置路由条目

DeleteTransitRouterRouteTable.description_en: Deletes a custom route table from an Enterprise Edition transit router by calling the DeleteTransitRouterRouteTable operation
DeleteTransitRouterRouteTable.description_zh: 调用DeleteTransitRouterRouteTable接口删除企业版转发路由器的自定义路由表

DeleteTransitRouterVbrAttachment.description_en: Deletes a virtual border router (VBR) connection from an Enterprise Edition transit router
DeleteTransitRouterVbrAttachment.description_zh: 调用DeleteTransitRouterVbrAttachment接口删除企业版转发路由器下的边界路由器VBR（Virtual border router）连接

DeleteTransitRouterVpcAttachment.description_en: Calls the DeleteTransitRouterVpcAttachment operation to delete a virtual private cloud (VPC) connection from an Enterprise Edition transit router
DeleteTransitRouterVpcAttachment.description_zh: 调用DeleteTransitRouterVpcAttachment接口删除企业版转发路由器下的专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）连接

DeleteTransitRouterVpnAttachment.description_en: Deletes a VPN connection by calling the DeleteTransitRouterVpnAttachment operation

DeregisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupMem.description_en: Removes a multicast member from a multicast group if the member no longer needs to receive multicast traffic by calling the DeregisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupMembers operation
DeregisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupMem.description_zh: 如果您不需要某个组播成员再接收组播流量，您可以调用DeregisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupMembers接口将该组播成员从组播组中删除

DeregisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupSou.description_en: Removes a multicast source from a multicast group if you no longer need the multicast source to send multicast traffic
DeregisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupSou.description_zh: 如果您不需要某个组播源再发送组播流量，您可以调用DeregisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupSources接口将该组播源从组播组中删除

DescribeCenAttachedChildInstanceAttribut.description_en: Queries the details of a network instance (VPC, VBR, or CCN) attached to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance, including the attachment status and network instance type
DescribeCenAttachedChildInstanceAttribut.description_zh: 调用DescribeCenAttachedChildInstanceAttribute接口查看加载到CEN中的网络实例（VPC、VBR、CCN）的网络实例的加载状态、网络实例的类型等详细信息

DescribeCenAttachedChildInstances.description_en: Queries information about network instances attached to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
DescribeCenAttachedChildInstances.description_zh: 调用DescribeCenAttachedChildInstances接口查询云企业网实例下已加载的网络实例信息

DescribeCenBandwidthPackages.description_en: Queries information about bandwidth package instances by calling the DescribeCenBandwidthPackages operation
DescribeCenBandwidthPackages.description_zh: 调用DescribeCenBandwidthPackages接口查询带宽包实例的信息

DescribeCenChildInstanceRouteEntries.description_en: Invokes the DescribeCenChildInstanceRouteEntries operation to query the route entries of a network instance in a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
DescribeCenChildInstanceRouteEntries.description_zh: 调用DescribeCenChildInstanceRouteEntries接口查询云企业网中网络实例的路由条目信息

DescribeCenGeographicSpanRemainingBandwi.description_en: Queries the remaining bandwidth of a specified bandwidth plan instance
DescribeCenGeographicSpanRemainingBandwi.description_zh: 查询指定带宽包实例的剩余带宽值

DescribeCenGeographicSpans.description_en: Queries information about connected areas supported by Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) by calling the DescribeCenGeographicSpans operation
DescribeCenGeographicSpans.description_zh: 调用DescribeCenGeographicSpans接口查询云企业网支持的互通区域的信息

DescribeCenInterRegionBandwidthLimits.description_en: Queries the inter-region bandwidth information between regions by calling the DescribeCenInterRegionBandwidthLimits operation
DescribeCenInterRegionBandwidthLimits.description_zh: 调用DescribeCenInterRegionBandwidthLimits接口查询各个地域之间的跨地域互通带宽的信息

DescribeCenPrivateZoneRoutes.description_en: Queries the PrivateZone service configuration of a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
DescribeCenPrivateZoneRoutes.description_zh: 调用DescribeCenPrivateZoneRoutes接口查询云企业网实例的PrivateZone服务配置信息

DescribeCenRegionDomainRouteEntries.description_en: Queries the details of route entries in a specific region of a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
DescribeCenRegionDomainRouteEntries.description_zh: 调用DescribeCenRegionDomainRouteEntries接口查询云企业网实例中具体地域内路由条目的详细信息

DescribeCenRouteMaps.description_en: Queries the configured information in route maps by calling the DescribeCenRouteMaps operation
DescribeCenRouteMaps.description_zh: 调用DescribeCenRouteMaps接口查询路由策略中已配置信息

DescribeCenVbrHealthCheck.description_en: Queries health check information about virtual border routers (VBRs) in a specified region
DescribeCenVbrHealthCheck.description_zh: 查询指定地域内边界路由器（VBR）健康检查信息

DescribeCens.description_en: Queries information about Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instances under the current Alibaba Cloud account, including the instance status, whether IPv6 is enabled, and the list of bandwidth packages associated with the instances
DescribeCens.description_zh: 调用DescribeCens接口查询当前阿里云账号下的云企业网实例的状态、是否已开启IPv6功能、实例绑定的带宽包的列表等信息

DescribeChildInstanceRegions.description_en: Queries the regions that support network instances loaded to Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN)
DescribeChildInstanceRegions.description_zh: 调用DescribeChildInstanceRegions接口查询云企业网支持加载网络实例的地域信息

DescribeGeographicRegionMembership.description_en: Queries region information within a specified area
DescribeGeographicRegionMembership.description_zh: 查询指定区域内的地域信息

DescribeGrantRulesToCen.description_en: Queries information about cross-account network instances that are authorized to be associated with a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
DescribeGrantRulesToCen.description_zh: 调用DescribeGrantRulesToCen接口查询云企业网实例已获得授权的跨账号的网络实例的信息

DescribeGrantRulesToResource.description_en: Queries the authorization information of a network instance for a cross-account Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance, including the Alibaba Cloud account ID of the CEN instance owner and the payer of the network instance
DescribeGrantRulesToResource.description_zh: 调用DescribeGrantRulesToResource接口查询网络实例对跨账号云企业网实例的授权信息，包括云企业网实例所属阿里云账号（主账号）、网络实例的付费方等信息

DescribePublishedRouteEntries.description_en: Queries the publish status, next hop associated instance type, and whether publishing or withdrawing is allowed for route entries of network instances (VPCs and VBRs) that are loaded into a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
DescribePublishedRouteEntries.description_zh: 您可以调用DescribePublishedRouteEntries接口查询已加载到CEN网络实例（VPC和VBR）的各条路由在CEN中的发布状态、路由条目下一跳关联的实例类型、是否允许发布或撤销该路由到云企业网等信息

DescribeRouteConflict.description_en: Queries information about conflicting route entries in a network instance
DescribeRouteConflict.description_zh: 调用DescribeRouteConflict接口查询网络实例中存在冲突的路由条目信息

DescribeRouteServicesInCen.description_en: Queries the cloud service configurations under a Basic Edition transit router by calling the DescribeRouteServicesInCen operation
DescribeRouteServicesInCen.description_zh: 调用DescribeRouteServicesInCen接口查询基础版转发路由器下的云服务配置信息

DescribeTransitRouteTableAggregation.description_en: Queries aggregate routes in an Enterprise Edition transit router route table
DescribeTransitRouteTableAggregation.description_zh: 查询企业版转发路由器路由表下的聚合路由

DescribeTransitRouteTableAggregationDeta.description_en: Queries the configuration details of a specified aggregate route
DescribeTransitRouteTableAggregationDeta.description_zh: 查询指定聚合路由的配置详情

DetachCenChildInstance.description_en: Detaches a network instance from a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
DetachCenChildInstance.description_zh: 调用DetachCenChildInstance接口卸载云企业网实例中的网络实例

DisableCenVbrHealthCheck.description_en: Disables health checks for a specified virtual border router (VBR)
DisableCenVbrHealthCheck.description_zh: 关闭指定边界路由器（VBR）的健康检查

DisableTransitRouterRouteTablePropagatio.description_en: Disables route learning between a network instance connection and a transit router route table

DisassociateTransitRouterMulticastDomain.description_en: Disassociates a vSwitch from a multicast domain
DisassociateTransitRouterMulticastDomain.description_zh: 调用DisassociateTransitRouterMulticastDomain接口解除交换机与组播域的关联关系

DissociateTransitRouterAttachmentFromRou.description_en: Dissociates a network instance connection from a route table

EnableCenVbrHealthCheck.description_en: Enables the health check feature for a virtual border router (VBR) to detect faults on physical Express Connect circuits in a timely manner. You can also use this operation to modify the health check configuration of a VBR
EnableCenVbrHealthCheck.description_zh: 开启边界路由器（VBR）的健康检查功能，确保及时发现出现故障的物理专线，也可修改VBR的健康检查配置

GrantInstanceToTransitRouter.description_en: Grants permissions to a transit router instance to connect to a network instance that belongs to a different Alibaba Cloud account. Before a transit router instance can connect to a network instance that belongs to a different account, the network instance owner must authorize the transit router instance by calling the GrantInstanceToTransitRouter operation
GrantInstanceToTransitRouter.description_zh: 在转发路由器实例连接其他账号的网络实例前，需要其他账号的网络实例对转发路由器实例进行授权。调用GrantInstanceToTransitRouter接口为转发路由器实例进行授权

ListCenChildInstanceRouteEntriesToAttach.description_en: Queries route entries that forward traffic to a network instance connection in the route table of a network instance associated with an Enterprise Edition transit router
ListCenChildInstanceRouteEntriesToAttach.description_zh: 调用ListCenChildInstanceRouteEntriesToAttachment接口查询企业版转发路由器下网络实例路由表中指向网络实例连接的路由条目

ListCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicies.description_en: Queries information about traffic scheduling policies by calling the ListCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicies operation
ListCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicies.description_zh: 调用ListCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicies接口查询流量调度策略的信息

ListCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueues.description_en: Queries information about traffic scheduling policy queues by calling the ListCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueues operation
ListCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueues.description_zh: 调用ListCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueues接口查询流量调度策略队列的信息

ListGrantVSwitchEnis.description_en: Queries the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) within a virtual private cloud (VPC) that can serve as multicast sources or multicast members for multicast communication
ListGrantVSwitchEnis.description_zh: 调用ListGrantVSwitchEnis接口查询在一个专有网络内部，哪些弹性网卡的配置可以成为组播源或者组播成员用来进行组播通信

ListGrantVSwitchesToCen.description_en: Queries information about vSwitches in a cross-account virtual private cloud (VPC) that is connected to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
ListGrantVSwitchesToCen.description_zh: 调用ListGrantVSwitchesToCen接口查询云企业网实例已连接的跨账号专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）下交换机的信息

ListTagResources.description_en: Queries the tags bound to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
ListTagResources.description_zh: 查询云企业网实例绑定的标签信息

ListTrafficMarkingPolicies.description_en: Queries details about traffic marking policies, such as the status and priority of the traffic marking policies
ListTrafficMarkingPolicies.description_zh: 调用ListTrafficMarkingPolicies接口查询流量标记策略的状态、流量标记策略的优先级等详细信息

ListTransitRouterAvailableResource.description_en: Queries the zones supported by Enterprise Edition transit routers in a specified region
ListTransitRouterAvailableResource.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterAvailableResource接口查询指定地域下企业版转发路由器支持的可用区信息

ListTransitRouterCidr.description_en: Queries information about CIDR blocks of a transit router by calling the ListTransitRouterCidr operation
ListTransitRouterCidr.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterCidr接口查询转发路由器下CIDR地址段的信息

ListTransitRouterCidrAllocation.description_en: Queries the allocation information of a CIDR block by calling the ListTransitRouterCidrAllocation operation
ListTransitRouterCidrAllocation.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterCidrAllocation接口查询CIDR地址段的分配信息

ListTransitRouterEcrAttachments.description_en: Queries the connection information about Express Connect Router (ECR) instances under an Enterprise Edition transit router, including the total number of entries, connection status, connection IDs, and the payer of network instances
ListTransitRouterEcrAttachments.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterEcrAttachments接口查询企业版转发路由器下的专线网关ECR总条目数、连接的状态、连接 ID、网络实例的付费方等连接信息

ListTransitRouterMulticastDomainAssociat.description_en: Queries the associations between a multicast domain and vSwitches
ListTransitRouterMulticastDomainAssociat.description_zh: 您可以调用ListTransitRouterMulticastDomainAssociations接口查询组播域和交换机的关联关系

ListTransitRouterMulticastDomainVSwitche.description_en: Queries information about vSwitches that are associated with multicast domains in a VPC-connected instance after the VPC-connected instance is connected to an Enterprise Edition transit router
ListTransitRouterMulticastDomainVSwitche.description_zh: VPC实例连接至企业版转发路由器后，您可以调用ListTransitRouterMulticastDomainVSwitches接口查询VPC实例下已绑定组播域的交换机的信息

ListTransitRouterMulticastDomains.description_en: Queries information about multicast domains, such as the status, multicast domain ID, and description of multicast domains
ListTransitRouterMulticastDomains.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterMulticastDomains接口查询组播域的状态、组播域ID、组播域的描述等信息

ListTransitRouterMulticastGroups.description_en: Queries the details of multicast members and multicast sources in a multicast domain
ListTransitRouterMulticastGroups.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterMulticastGroups接口查询组播域下组播成员和组播源的详细信息

ListTransitRouterPeerAttachments.description_en: Queries the details of inter-region connections under an Enterprise Edition transit router by calling the ListTransitRouterPeerAttachments operation
ListTransitRouterPeerAttachments.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterPeerAttachments接口查询企业版转发路由器下的跨地域连接的详细信息

ListTransitRouterPrefixListAssociation.description_en: Queries information about prefix lists associated with an Enterprise Edition transit router route table
ListTransitRouterPrefixListAssociation.description_zh: 查询企业版转发路由器路由表绑定的前缀列表的信息

ListTransitRouterRouteEntries.description_en: Calls the ListTransitRouterRouteEntries operation to query the details of route entries in an Enterprise Edition transit router route table
ListTransitRouterRouteEntries.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterRouteEntries接口查询企业版转发路由器路由表中的路由条目的详细信息

ListTransitRouterRouteTableAssociations.description_en: Queries the route association relationships created for an Enterprise Edition transit router route table or a network instance connection
ListTransitRouterRouteTableAssociations.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterRouteTableAssociations接口查询企业版转发路由器路由表或网络实例连接已创建的关联转发关系

ListTransitRouterRouteTablePropagations.description_en: Queries the route learning relationships of an Enterprise Edition transit router route table
ListTransitRouterRouteTablePropagations.description_zh: 查询企业版转发路由器路由表的路由学习关系

ListTransitRouterRouteTables.description_en: Queries the details of route tables of an Enterprise Edition transit router by calling the ListTransitRouterRouteTables operation
ListTransitRouterRouteTables.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterRouteTables接口查询企业版转发路由器的路由表的详细信息

ListTransitRouterVbrAttachments.description_en: Queries the connection information of virtual border routers (VBRs) under an Enterprise Edition transit router, including the total number of entries, connection status, connection IDs, and payers of network instances
ListTransitRouterVbrAttachments.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterVbrAttachments接口查询企业版转发路由器下的边界路由器VBR总条目数、连接的状态、连接 ID、网络实例的付费方等连接信息

ListTransitRouterVpcAttachments.description_en: Queries information about Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) connections under an Enterprise Edition transit router, including the status, billing type, zone information, and associated vSwitch and network interface controller (NIC) details of VPC connections that are active for forwarding and routing traffic
ListTransitRouterVpcAttachments.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterVpcAttachments接口查询企业版转发路由器下专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）VPC连接的状态、VPC连接的付费类型、VPC连接的可用区信息及其关联的VPC实例的交换机和弹性网卡信息等

ListTransitRouterVpnAttachments.description_en: Queries information about VPN connections, such as the status, IPsec connection ID, and billing method of VPN connections
ListTransitRouterVpnAttachments.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterVpnAttachment接口查询VPN连接的状态、IPsec连接ID、VPN连接的付费类型等信息

ListTransitRouters.description_en: Queries information about transit router instances under a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance, including the instance type, instance status, transit router instance ID, and whether the multicast feature is enabled
ListTransitRouters.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouters接口查询云企业网实例下转发路由器实例的实例类型、实例的状态、转发路由器实例ID、是否开启了组播功能等信息

ModifyCenAttribute.description_en: Modifies the name and description of a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
ModifyCenAttribute.description_zh: 调用ModifyCenAttribute接口修改云企业网实例的名称和描述信息

ModifyCenBandwidthPackageAttribute.description_en: Modifies the name and description of a bandwidth plan instance by calling the ModifyCenBandwidthPackageAttribute operation
ModifyCenBandwidthPackageAttribute.description_zh: 调用ModifyCenBandwidthPackageAttribute接口修改带宽包实例的名称和描述信息

ModifyCenBandwidthPackageSpec.description_en: Modifies the peak bandwidth of a bandwidth plan instance by calling the ModifyCenBandwidthPackageSpec operation
ModifyCenBandwidthPackageSpec.description_zh: 调用ModifyCenBandwidthPackageSpec接口修改带宽包实例的带宽峰值

ModifyCenRouteMap.description_en: Modifies a routing policy by calling the ModifyCenRouteMap operation
ModifyCenRouteMap.description_zh: 调用ModifyCenRouteMap接口修改路由策略

ModifyFlowLogAttribute.description_en: Modifies the name, description, and capture window duration of a flow log
ModifyFlowLogAttribute.description_zh: 编辑流日志的名称、描述以及捕获窗口时长

ModifyGrantInstanceToTransitRouter.description_en: Modifies the payer for a cross-account network instance connection of a transit router instance
ModifyGrantInstanceToTransitRouter.description_zh: 调用ModifyGrantInstanceToTransitRouter接口编辑转发路由器实例连接跨账号网络实例的资费承担方

ModifyTrafficMatchRuleToTrafficMarkingPo.description_en: Modifies the name and description of a traffic classification rule
ModifyTrafficMatchRuleToTrafficMarkingPo.description_zh: 编辑流分类规则的名称和描述

ModifyTransitRouterCidr.description_en: Calls the ModifyTransitRouterCidr operation to modify a CIDR block of a transit router
ModifyTransitRouterCidr.description_zh: 调用ModifyTransitRouterCidr接口修改转发路由器下的CIDR地址段

ModifyTransitRouterMulticastDomain.description_en: Modifies the name, description, and feature options of a multicast domain
ModifyTransitRouterMulticastDomain.description_zh: 调用ModifyTransitRouterMulticastDomain接口修改组播域的名称、描述信息以及功能选项

MoveResourceGroup.description_en: Modifies the resource group to which a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance or a bandwidth plan instance belongs
MoveResourceGroup.description_zh: 调用MoveResourceGroup接口修改云企业网实例或带宽包实例所属的资源组

PublishRouteEntries.description_en: Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) supports the publish route entry feature. You can publish routing entries from a VPC or VBR loaded into CEN to CEN by invoking the PublishRouteEntries operation. If no route conflict exists, other network instances in CEN can learn the published routes
PublishRouteEntries.description_zh: 云企业网支持发布路由的功能。您可以将加载到云企业网中的VPC或VBR中的路由通过调用PublishRouteEntries接口发布到云企业网中，在没有路由冲突的情况下，云企业网中的其他网络实例可以学习到该路由

RegisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupMembe.description_en: Calls the RegisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupMembers operation to create or add multicast members
RegisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupMembe.description_zh: 调用RegisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupMembers接口创建或添加组播成员

RegisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupSourc.description_en: Creates multicast sources to implement one-to-many multicast communication
RegisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupSourc.description_zh: 为了实现一对多的组播通信，调用RegisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupSources接口创建组播源

RemoveTrafficMatchRuleFromTrafficMarking.description_en: Removes traffic classification rules from a traffic marking policy by calling the RemoveTrafficMatchRuleFromTrafficMarkingPolicy operation
RemoveTrafficMatchRuleFromTrafficMarking.description_zh: 调用RemoveTrafficMatchRuleFromTrafficMarkingPolicy接口删除流量标记策略下的流分类规则

RemoveTraficMatchRuleFromTrafficMarkingP.description_en: Deletes traffic classification rules from a traffic marking policy
RemoveTraficMatchRuleFromTrafficMarkingP.description_zh: 删除流量标记策略下的流分类规则

ReplaceTransitRouterRouteTableAssociatio.description_en: Replaces the transit router route table associated with a network instance connection
ReplaceTransitRouterRouteTableAssociatio.description_zh: 更换网络实例连接关联的转发路由器路由表

ResolveAndRouteServiceInCen.description_en: Configures a cloud service to add access configurations for on-premises networks by calling the ResolveAndRouteServiceInCen operation
ResolveAndRouteServiceInCen.description_zh: 您可以通过调用ResolveAndRouteServiceInCen接口设置云服务，为本地网络添加访问云服务的配置

RevokeInstanceFromTransitRouter.description_en: Revokes the permissions that allow a transit router to connect to a cross-account network instance
RevokeInstanceFromTransitRouter.description_zh: 调用RevokeInstanceFromTransitRouter接口取消转发路由器实例连接跨账号网络实例的权限

RoutePrivateZoneInCenToVpc.description_en: Configures the PrivateZone service by calling the RoutePrivateZoneInCenToVpc operation

SetCenInterRegionBandwidthLimit.description_en: Sets, modifies, or deletes the inter-region bandwidth between two regions in a bandwidth package of a Basic Edition transit router
SetCenInterRegionBandwidthLimit.description_zh: 调用SetCenInterRegionBandwidthLimit接口设置、修改或删除基础版转发路由器带宽包中两个地域间的跨地域互通带宽

TagResources.description_en: Creates and attaches tags to resources
TagResources.description_zh: 为资源创建并绑定标签

TempUpgradeCenBandwidthPackageSpec.description_en: Calls the TempUpgradeCenBandwidthPackageSpec operation to temporarily upgrade the specifications of a subscription bandwidth plan for Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN)
TempUpgradeCenBandwidthPackageSpec.description_zh: 调用TempUpgradeCenBandwidthPackageSpec接口对云企业网预付费带宽包实例临时升配

UnassociateCenBandwidthPackage.description_en: Disassociates a bandwidth package from a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance. After the disassociation, the bandwidth package can be associated with another CEN instance
UnassociateCenBandwidthPackage.description_zh: 调用UnassociateCenBandwidthPackage接口解绑带宽包与云企业网实例之间的绑定，解绑后该带宽包可以绑定至其他云企业网实例

UnroutePrivateZoneInCenToVpc.description_en: Deletes a PrivateZone service configuration by calling the UnroutePrivateZoneInCenToVpc operation

UpdateCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicyAttr.description_en: Modifies the name and description of a traffic scheduling policy
UpdateCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicyAttr.description_zh: 调用UpdateCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicyAttribute接口修改流量调度策略的名称和描述信息

UpdateCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueueAttri.description_en: Calls the UpdateCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueueAttribute operation to modify the name, description, cross-region bandwidth, and DSCP value configurations of a queue in a traffic scheduling policy
UpdateCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueueAttri.description_zh: 调用UpdateCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueueAttribute接口修改流量调度策略下队列的名称、描述、跨地域带宽、DSCP值的配置

UpdateTrafficMarkingPolicyAttribute.description_en: Modifies the name, description, and traffic classification rules of a traffic marking policy
UpdateTrafficMarkingPolicyAttribute.description_zh: 调用UpdateTrafficMarkingPolicyAttribute接口修改流量标记策略的名称，描述信息以及流分类规则

UpdateTransitRouter.description_en: Modifies the name and description of a transit router instance
UpdateTransitRouter.description_zh: 调用UpdateTransitRouter接口修改转发路由器实例的名称和描述信息

UpdateTransitRouterEcrAttachmentAttribut.description_en: Calls the UpdateTransitRouterEcrAttachmentAttribute operation to modify the name and description of an Express Connect Router (ECR) connection under an Enterprise Edition transit router
UpdateTransitRouterEcrAttachmentAttribut.description_zh: 调用UpdateTransitRouterEcrAttachmentAttribute接口修改企业版转发路由器下ECR连接的名称、描述信息

UpdateTransitRouterPeerAttachmentAttribu.description_en: Modifies the configuration of an inter-region connection on an Enterprise Edition transit router by calling the UpdateTransitRouterPeerAttachmentAttribute operation
UpdateTransitRouterPeerAttachmentAttribu.description_zh: 调用UpdateTransitRouterPeerAttachmentAttribute接口修改企业版转发路由器下跨地域连接的配置

UpdateTransitRouterRouteEntry.description_en: Modifies the name and description of a route entry in an Enterprise Edition transit router route table
UpdateTransitRouterRouteEntry.description_zh: 修改企业版转发路由器路由表中路由条目的名称和描述信息

UpdateTransitRouterRouteTable.description_en: Calls the UpdateTransitRouterRouteTable operation to modify the name and description of an Enterprise Edition transit router route table and to enable or disable multi-region equal-cost multi-path (ECMP) routing
UpdateTransitRouterRouteTable.description_zh: 调用UpdateTransitRouterRouteTable接口修改企业版转发路由器路由表的名称、描述信息和开启或关闭多地域等价路由

UpdateTransitRouterVbrAttachmentAttribut.description_en: Modifies the name, description, and automatic route forwarding settings of a virtual border router (VBR) connection on an Enterprise Edition transit router
UpdateTransitRouterVbrAttachmentAttribut.description_zh: 调用UpdateTransitRouterVbrAttachmentAttribute接口修改企业版转发路由器下VBR连接的名称、描述信息、是否允许自动发布路由

UpdateTransitRouterVpcAttachmentAttribut.description_en: Invokes the UpdateTransitRouterVpcAttachmentAttribute operation to modify the name and description of a VPC connection under an Enterprise Edition transit router and specifies whether the Enterprise Edition transit router automatically publishes routing to the VPC-connected instance
UpdateTransitRouterVpcAttachmentAttribut.description_zh: 调用UpdateTransitRouterVpcAttachmentAttribute接口修改企业版转发路由器下VPC连接的名称和描述信息以及是否需要使企业版转发路由器自动发布路由到 VPC 实例

UpdateTransitRouterVpcAttachmentZones.description_en: Modifies the zones and vSwitches associated with a virtual private cloud (VPC) connection by calling the UpdateTransitRouterVpcAttachmentZones operation
UpdateTransitRouterVpcAttachmentZones.description_zh: 调用UpdateTransitRouterVpcAttachmentZones接口修改专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）连接关联的可用区和交换机

UpdateTransitRouterVpnAttachmentAttribut.description_en: Calls the UpdateTransitRouterVpnAttachmentAttribute operation to modify the name, description, and whether to automatically publish route entries for a VPN connection under an Enterprise Edition transit router
UpdateTransitRouterVpnAttachmentAttribut.description_zh: 调用UpdateTransitRouterVpnAttachmentAttribute接口修改企业版转发路由器下VPN连接的名称、描述信息、是否允许自动发布路由

WithdrawPublishedRouteEntries.description_en: Calls the WithdrawPublishedRouteEntries operation to withdraw routing entries that have been published from a virtual private cloud (VPC) or virtual border router (VBR) instance to Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN)
WithdrawPublishedRouteEntries.description_zh: 调用WithdrawPublishedRouteEntries接口撤回专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）或边界路由器VBR（Virtual border router）实例已发布至云企业网的路由条目
